name: Spud
personality: The main character (Jonny, 11 Nov 2026). The one normal potato among the fighters, kept neutral on purpose: no quirk, no type. Wants an ordinary day, reacts the way the average person would, goes along with his friends. The fighters carry the quirks; he is the straight man the viewer stands in for.
voiceNote: gibberish, mid and plain (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: No hat, no weapon, no prop. His only costume piece is the teal knit sweater (costumes-art-cast.js spud): rolled collar, rolled hem and cuffs, one patch on the LEFT elbow. Brown boots = limbs.color. About 85 % of a fighter's height.
